title: Tonal repeat
headline:

description: Large split capsules repeat across the entire forest canvas. Alternating green halves build a continuous surface behind the lime headline, with one blue inflection.
patternRule: Repeat a broad split capsule on staggered rows. Keep both halves in close forest tones; use the shape of their join and the row offset to create rhythm across the full image.
gradientRule: Flat tonal colors. One capsule half shifts toward blue; the headline provides the main lime contrast.
coverageRule: The repeat fills all four edges and continues behind the headline. Dominant forest color means a tonal surface, not empty space.
paletteName: Forest / tonal green / blue / lime type
typography: DM Sans · weight 450 · 110 px · 125 px line spacing · −4.95 px tracking

title: Oversized planes
headline:
Choose your first

description: Monumental folded planes span the canvas. Dark blue surfaces support the headline while a broad cyan face and a low crossing plane make the artwork feel dimensional.
patternRule: Use a few huge overlapping diagonal planes that extend beyond the frame. Vary their angle and width, and let a second direction interrupt the dominant fold. Keep dark blue behind white text.
gradientRule: Light follows two defined faces. Other planes stay flat; a narrow lime edge marks one fold without creating a background glow.
coverageRule: Defined planes occupy the full surface, including behind the headline. Pattern structure reaches every edge; no isolated corner object.
paletteName: Deep blue / blue / cyan / small lime edge
typography: DM Sans · weight 450 · 110 px · 125 px line spacing · −4.95 px tracking

title: Woven field
headline:

description: Wide diagonal bands weave over and under across the full pale canvas. Two blue strands enter on the right while the softer weave continues behind the headline.
patternRule: Build a large twill from two sets of broad intersecting bands, alternating which strand passes above. Continue the structure through all edges, with a few stronger strands away from the headline.
gradientRule: Flat pale tones throughout the weave. Two blue strands supply the stronger color change; no corner gradient or lighting overlay.
coverageRule: The woven structure occupies every edge and extends under the text. Pale tonal contrast keeps the headline readable while the pattern covers most of the frame.
paletteName: Pale blue / tonal blue-white / cyan / blue
typography: DM Sans · weight 450 · 110 px · 125 px line spacing · −4.95 px tracking

title: Monumental layers
description: Huge angled layers extend beyond the frame. Their scale turns the entire cover into the pattern.
patternRule: Use several off-axis rounded trapezoids, each larger than the canvas. Change the inset and angle subtly between layers.
gradientRule: Pale lime gives the headline contrast. Soft lime-to-mint transitions belong to two broad inner layers.
coverageRule: Oversized forms occupy most of the canvas and extend across all four edges; the headline sits directly on the artwork.
typography: DM Sans · weight 450 · 110 px · 125 px line spacing · −4.95 px tracking

title: Pattern under paper
description: A dense blue tile field fills the cover, with a small white panel giving the headline its own place.
patternRule: Repeat alternating curved tile shapes at a slight angle. Keep the pattern large enough to read as shapes at thumbnail size.
gradientRule: Use flat blue and cyan values for the field, one lime accent, and a solid white reading panel.
coverageRule: Pattern covers the whole canvas. A reading panel covers about 18%, leaving an active surface around every side.
typography: DM Sans · weight 450 · 110 px · 125 px line spacing · −4.95 px tracking

title: Broad sweep
description: Wide directional bands sweep across the full frame, shifting in width and color as they pass behind the headline.
patternRule: Use broad filled bands spanning top to bottom, with a gradual bend across the composition. Avoid thin contour lines.
gradientRule: Alternate deep and medium blue faces. A cyan transition appears in one band; dark blue remains beneath the white text.
coverageRule: Bands span the whole canvas, including behind the type. There is no separate empty field or corner ornament.
typography: DM Sans · weight 450 · 110 px · 125 px line spacing · −4.95 px tracking
